t: Simon Says Make MCP Tool-call: Teaching a Local LLM to Use Tools
s: This article details the refactoring of a local LLM interaction function from a rigid, guaranteed-success prototype to a more flexible 'process_llm_interaction' orchestrator. It emphasizes the practical engineering and philosophical trade-offs in making local AI truly useful through robust tool-calling.
sub: Pipulate framework and 'Write Everything Twice' (WET) philosophy
Machine-Readable Common Protocol (MCP) for LLM tool-calling
Transitioning from rigid MCP prototype to flexible interaction processing
Refactoring 'chat_with_llm' to 'process_llm_interaction' for clarity and convention
AI collaboration and embracing LLM 'hallucinations' for convention alignment
